CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (
    user_id,
    display_name
  )
  values (
    new.id,
    coalesce(
      new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'display_name',
      split_part(new.email, '@', 1)
    )
  )
  on conflict (user_id) do nothing;

  return new;
end;
$function$
functions.name: handle_new_user

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_household_with_baby(household_name text, baby_name text, baby_birth_date date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  current_user_id uuid;
  new_household_id uuid;
  new_baby_id uuid;
begin

  -- ----------------------------------------------------------
  -- 1. Require authenticated user
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------

  current_user_id := auth.uid();

  if current_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required';
  end if;


  -- ----------------------------------------------------------
  -- 2. Validate household name
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------

  household_name := trim(household_name);

  if household_name is null
     or char_length(household_name) < 1
     or char_length(household_name) > 100 then
    raise exception 'Invalid household name';
  end if;


  -- ----------------------------------------------------------
  -- 3. Validate baby name
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------

  baby_name := trim(baby_name);

  if baby_name is null
     or char_length(baby_name) < 1
     or char_length(baby_name) > 100 then
    raise exception 'Invalid baby name';
  end if;


  -- ----------------------------------------------------------
  -- 4. Prevent future birth dates
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------

  if baby_birth_date is not null
     and baby_birth_date > current_date then
    raise exception 'Birth date cannot be in the future';
  end if;


  -- ----------------------------------------------------------
  -- 5. Create household
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------

  insert into public.households (
    name,
    created_by_user_id
  )
  values (
    household_name,
    current_user_id
  )
  returning id
  into new_household_id;


  -- ----------------------------------------------------------
  -- 6. Make current user owner
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------

  insert into public.household_members (
    household_id,
    user_id,
    role
  )
  values (
    new_household_id,
    current_user_id,
    'owner'
  );


  -- ----------------------------------------------------------
  -- 7. Create baby
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------

  insert into public.babies (
    name,
    birth_date,
    created_by_user_id
  )
  values (
    baby_name,
    baby_birth_date,
    current_user_id
  )
  returning id
  into new_baby_id;


  -- ----------------------------------------------------------
  -- 8. Connect baby to household
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------

  insert into public.baby_households (
    baby_id,
    household_id
  )
  values (
    new_baby_id,
    new_household_id
  );


  -- ----------------------------------------------------------
  -- 9. Return created IDs
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'household_id', new_household_id,
    'baby_id', new_baby_id
  );

end;
$function$
functions.name: create_household_with_baby
